# Mutual-TLS input dedicated to authenticated local0 application traffic.
global(
  DefaultNetstreamDriver="gtls"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverCAFile="/etc/rsyslog-tls/ca.pem"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverCertFile="/etc/rsyslog-tls/server-cert.pem"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverKeyFile="/etc/rsyslog-tls/server-key.pem"
)

module(load="imtcp")

ruleset(name="remote_local0") {
  if ($syslogfacility-text == "local0" and $fromhost-ip == "10.100.135.10") then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/remote-apps/node1.log" fileCreateMode="0640")
    stop
  }
  if ($syslogfacility-text == "local0" and $fromhost-ip == "10.100.135.11") then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/remote-apps/node2.log" fileCreateMode="0640")
    stop
  }
  if ($syslogfacility-text == "local0" and $fromhost-ip == "10.100.135.12") then {
    action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/remote-apps/node3.log" fileCreateMode="0640")
    stop
  }
  stop
}

input(
  type="imtcp"
  port="6514"
  ruleset="remote_local0"
  StreamDriver.Name="gtls"
  StreamDriver.Mode="1"
  StreamDriver.AuthMode="x509/name"
  PermittedPeer=["node1","node2","node3"]
)
ANTRIEB_RSYSLOG
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/remote-apps <<'ANTRIEB_ROTATE'
/var/log/remote-apps/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 root root
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /bin/systemctl kill -s HUP rsyslog.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}
